Conventional teaching gives internal rotation of about 10 to 15 degrees at 90 degrees of flexion.
Total axial rotation, internal and external together, is conventionally given as about 25 to 30 degrees at 90 degrees of flexion, with external rotation taking the larger share.
The pivot shift is graded 0 to 3 by feel, and interobserver agreement is moderate at best.
